story.title: Story 3: Message Projection and Token Estimates

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on F-03-002 and directly touched schema-open/read/write surfaces. The identity probe now rejects non-thread files before migration, valid Story 2 files still migrate to v2, focused checks pass, and both configured gates pass.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved. `validateThreadFile` opens a read-only handle and requires `user_version >= 1`, a `thread_metadata` table, and the singleton row before any migration (`packages/lhc/src/domains/threads/internal/create.ts:101-136`). `openThreadDatabase` now returns an `OpResult<DatabaseSync>` and runs migrations only after that identity check (`create.ts:145-160`). `runMessageEvents`, `runListEvents`, and `listMessages` propagate failed opens instead of migrating (`pipeline.ts:100-106`, `pipeline.ts:225-227`, `messages/index.ts:92-98`). `test/thread-migration.test.ts:151-218` verifies empty database, unrelated SQLite database, and text file rejection without schema mutation or byte/content loss. An independent TSX probe confirmed empty files keep `user_version: 0` and no tables, foreign DBs keep only `notes`, and text bytes stay unchanged.

verified: F-03-002: non-thread existing files are rejected as caller_error/thread_not_found without LHC schema adoption or mutation, covered by `test/thread-migration.test.ts` and an independent TSX probe.
F-03-001 remains covered: valid Story 2 user_version=1 files migrate before message write/read, preserve existing events, continue event order, and keep legacy idempotency skips inert.
AC-2.2 through AC-2.6 and AC-5.4 remain covered by the Story 3 projection suite; focused `test/thread-migration.test.ts test/projection.test.ts` passed with 13 tests.
TC-2.4 spawned CLI leg remains covered; `LHC_PROCESS_SUITE=1 vitest run test/cli-process-projection.test.ts` passed.
Configured story gate `green-verify` passed with 62 tests and Red test immutability OK; epic gate `verify-all` passed with 72 tests including process-boundary suites.

additionalObservations: Production-path audit found no remaining material fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real execution path in the touched Story 3 message/migration path.
The non-SQLite classification depends on SQLite error text; current behavior is still rejection without adoption, and the focused text-file test covers the installed Node runtime.
The remaining `notImplemented` surfaces are planned future-story surfaces and outside this story scope.
